start_global_annotation: start a global MetaAnnotator for a pydipcc game writing annotations to a given output path
stop_global_annotation_and_commit: stop the global annotator and commit all annotations for a pydipcc game
read_annotations: read and parse annotation records from a file path into a ParsedData object with categorized entries
add_pseudo_orders_next_msg: add pseudo orders data to the global annotator for the next message timestamp
maybe_kickoff_annotations: use a context manager to optionally start and stop global annotations for a game
